note.title: Regular verb paradigms
note.overview: Recall all persons of present future imperfect perfect and pluperfect for four conjugations.
learningGoals: Produce five complete tenses of porto moneo traho and audio.
Recognise the different future pattern for third and fourth conjugations.
mustMemoriseRules: First and second conjugation future uses bo bis bit bimus bitis bunt.
Third and fourth conjugation future uses am es et emus etis ent, with i before the endings in fourth conjugation.
Pluperfect is perfect stem plus eram eras erat eramus eratis erant.

commonMistakes: Using portabo-style future for traho or audio.
Using a present stem instead of a perfect stem in the pluperfect.
A familiar stem with the wrong case, number, person or tense ending is not correct.
detailedExplanation: Recall all persons of present future imperfect perfect and pluperfect for four conjugations.

A Latin verb form combines stem, tense information and a personal ending. Work from the ending inward: identify person and number, then tense or mood, then translate with the correct time relationship.
examTips: Mark the finite verb first, then use noun endings to assign subject, object and recipient roles.
Normal Latin word order can vary; the case, number, gender, person and tense endings cannot.
For English to Latin, build each required form before arranging the sentence.
